decisive_items: an abnormally low transverse colon and right colic flexure
an abnormal superior mesenteric artery–vein relationship, with the vein coursing to the left of the artery
The third portion of the duodenum was not seen in its expected location
response.rationale: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with malrotation of the intestine, which is a congenital anomaly of the intestinal rotation.

rejected.why: The appendix appeared normal, contradicting the diagnosis of acute appendicitis.
The imaging findings do not support the diagnosis of inflammatory bowel disease.
The lack of ischemia makes the diagnosis of intestinal volvulus less likely.
The diagnosis of internal hernia is not as well-supported by the imaging findings as malrotation of the intestine.
